contract.assumptions: Complete mathematical interfaces only. The full uniform inference target ranges over all binary activities/initial populations, finite or infinite actual classes and full accuracy-bit length, and asks for both unconditional sampling and additive-epsilon log class mass. That target remains open. N1780’s full conservative fixed-Theta sampler allows polynomial epsilon^-1 cost and does not solve it. DLMF positive-real Stirling and weak-reversible cycle circulation are established machinery, credited once; no extra family impact score or novelty claim. Original source holds and governing-unread Kahle–Miller1107.4699v5 remain. No new original recovery or independent Capital audit.
contract.costs: Let L be complete binary input length. Choose an integer A>=2+L+d+sum lambda_i+sum x0_i+ceil(log(100d/epsilon)) by computable rational rounding, then U=100A^3 has O(L) bits. Numeric A,U may be enormous; no population enumeration up to U is performed. The tail proof pays a class anchor rather than a minimum conditioning probability. The order-r positive-real Stirling bound is explicit in Bernoulli coefficients and t, giving geometric decay when t>=8r; a complete uniform inference algorithm and all its evaluation/mixture costs remain unconstructed. Positive rational cycle flows and kappa_r=q_r/lambda^y_r are finite exact graph/algebra operations. Capital performs no Chernoff, factorial, compiler or sampler execution.
contract.obstruction: Construct the full uniform support/compiler, weighted mixture normalization, unconditional sampler and additive-accuracy log class mass with every-run cost polynomial in complete binary input, including accuracy bits. Tail and precision interfaces alone do not supply this theorem.
contract.provides: The coordinator supplies complete feasibility interfaces for a different uniform conditioned-Poisson inference question. An explicit binary-encodable cutoff controls tail mass relative to any actual class, including exponentially rare finite or infinite classes; positive-real higher-order Stirling remainders give a geometric accuracy opening; and positive cycle circulations realize arbitrary positive rational activities as complex-balanced equilibria on any fixed weakly reversible reaction structure. These do not construct the full uniform support, weighted mixture, sampler or log-conditioning-mass compiler. Any fixed weakly reversible reaction structure, positive rational activity vector lambda, initial population x0 in its actual class Gamma, and rational 0<epsilon<1. W_lambda(x)=product lambda_i^x_i/x_i!, with Z_Gamma>=W_lambda(x0)>0 and total unrestricted mass exp(sum lambda_i). Classes may be finite or infinite. Tail truncation retains original reachability; it never substitutes connectivity inside the cutoff cube. The higher-Stirling interface is for positive real t with t>=8r. Equilibrium realization chooses rates from cycle circulation; it is not a claim about arbitrary original unbalanced rates.

evidence.quote: ROOT ORIGINAL feasibility calculation for a DIFFERENT FULL uniform inference question: write W_lambda(x)=prod lambda_i^x_i/x_i!, F=-logW. For complete binary lengthL, choose integer A>=2+L+d+sum lambda_i+sum x0_i+ceil(log(100d/epsilon)), computable with rational rounding. Then F(x0)<=2A^2 (enlarging fixed numerical constants), sum lambda_i<=A, and for U=100A^3 the unrestricted Poisson Chernoff bound gives sum_{max x_i>=U} W_lambda(x)/W_lambda(x0) <=d*exp(A+2A^2)*(eA/U)^U<epsilon/100. Since Z_Gamma>=W_lambda(x0), this is a valid absolute-tail-to-CONDITIONAL-mass bound even for exponentially rare classes, with O(L) bits to encode U. Truncating the cube does NOT replace original reachability by connectivity inside the cube. Separately, positive-real log-Gamma remainder after orderr is <=|B_2r|/[2r(2r-1)t^(2r-1)]; using |B_2r|<=4(2r)!/(2pi)^(2r), t>=8r gives geometric-in-r error. This supplies an actual accuracy-bit opening beyond072's 1/n approximation; it does not yet supply the complete uniform support/compiler/mixture proof. For any weakly reversible structure and positive rational lambda, choose positive rational cycle-circulation q_r on its complex graph and kappa_r=q_r/lambda^y_r; complex balance atlambda follows. Thus the new conditioned-Poisson question includes genuinely nonconservative complex-balanced equilibria, rather than claiming arbitrary original non-balanced rates have that law.
